limitations: This evidence qualifies only the exact sampled-node rope self-contact behavior of the captured CUDA binary on the named physical device.
Nodes whose indices differ by two or less remain excluded; continuous segment, knot, splice and inter-rope contact are not claimed.
The unchanged rope-core lifecycle, capacity, replacement and rollback obligations remain independently required and are not substituted by this analytic fixture.
D3D12 remains unqualified for this record because the captured driver does not advertise rope support.
Historical and unrecaptured drivers remain unqualified; this capture does not promote them or erase their failures.
